# FileSize <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FileSize:Int32 file:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | In | String | required | The name of the file. Strings are stored with a 4 byte length in front, so "hello" takes 9 bytes. |

**Returns:** The size of a file in bytes, or 0 when it does not exist.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Examples

```blitzbasic
file = WriteFile("files_size_example.tmp")
WriteString file, "hello"
CloseFile file
Print FileSize("files_size_example.tmp")
DeleteFile "files_size_example.tmp"
```

```text
9
```
